documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR2,391 crores for Q2 FY27, up 61% year-on-year, with a reported PAT of INR129 crores. Management highlighted strong operational execution, growth in exports and value-added studded jewelry, improved working capital cycles, and a disciplined approach to capital deployment. The company noted that SEBI guidelines restrict them from providing explicit forward-looking guidance. Additionally, management addressed queries regarding acquisitions, internal controls, audits, and capital raising. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported its operational and financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, highlighting significant growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT compared to the previous year.

guidance.claim: The company remains on track to achieve its FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve an operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%.
guidance.quote: But our plan is that, overall, we are now targeting to have operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%, that we have also provided in our IP as well.

guidance.claim: Management targets overall PAT margin to be close to 5%.
guidance.quote: And our overall PAT margin will be close to 5%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that customers are consolidating their supplier base and prefer to work with fewer, larger, established, and compliant manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Importantly, our customers are working to consolidate their supplier base. They want to work with fewer larger, established, well-capitalized, professionally run and compliant jewelry manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed a shift in consumer preferences towards lower karatage jewelry as youngsters want to buy lower karatage at a budget.
demand_outlook.quote: Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat. So, 100% there is a shift and generations out change also, because youngsters want to buy lower karatage at a very decent budget.

demand_outlook.claim: Lower karatage products like 18 KT, 14 KT, and 9 KT have been gaining market share due to gold price appreciation.
demand_outlook.quote: Lower KT products like 18 KT, 14 KT, 9 KT have been gaining market share due to appreciation in appreciation.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's initial order from the UK exhibition stood at 25 to 30 kg.
demand_outlook.quote: We have done the first exhibition, and we have got a first initial order of 25 to 30 kg.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in the Asiana U.K. India Jewellery Expo resulted in a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across UK and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

capex_expansion.claim: Future capacity expansion after 2028 is expected to require a capex close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores under a leased model.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin expanded 133 basis points year-on-year to 9.6% for Q2 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit was INR229 crores, up 87%. Gross margin expanded 133 basis points to 9.6% versus Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Operating costs rose to 1.6% of sales due to investments in people including a CEO, larger design team, and stronger audit and finance functions.
margins_costs.quote: Operating costs rose to 1.6% of sales, as we invested in people: a CEO, a larger design team, and stronger audit and finance functions.

margins_costs.claim: The share of business for value-added products has increased in the recent period, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: • Margin Expansion: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 compared to 9.1% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, representing 7.8% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry increased from 10.5% in Q4 FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

margins_costs.claim: The share of studded jewelry increased from 1.65% in Q4 FY26 to 2.1% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The share of studded jewelry has also increased from 1.65% in Q4 '26 to 2.1% in Q1 '27, on account of management's focus on better-margin products.

orders_capacity.claim: The merchandising team successfully onboarded one of the Middle East's largest retail chains in record time.
orders_capacity.quote: • Global Market Penetration: Our merchandising team successfully onboarded one of the Middle East’s largest retail chains in record time—a feat notable because the typical sales cycle for such clients is considerably longer.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is close to 55% to 57% or around 60%.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total production capacity stands at 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt in the first half of FY27 is down 20% from FY26 levels when factoring in the land sale guided earlier.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, if we factor in the land sale we guided for earlier, net debt in first half FY27 is down 20% from FY26 level.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters committed to taking a salary only when there are operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: I can only comment on my promise now. Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt level for the quarter stood at INR540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company reported an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for a fraud incident at subsidiary Star Mangalsutra disclosed in July.
risks_headwinds.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra, disclosed in July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heightened volatility in gold prices created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: In recent quarters, heightened volatility in gold prices has created margin pressures across various retailers and manufacturers within the jewelry industry.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that if no interested buyer is finalized for the land monetization within 20 to 30 days, the promoters will purchase it.
management_commitments.quote: If we don't get a final commitment in this next 20 or 30 days, the promoters will purchase. But we intend not to be a related party transaction, that's why we have stretched one or two months.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, and all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Management will review and revise revenue guidance post Diwali after analyzing one more quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali. That's our plan.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to reach 52 days of working capital by 2030 under the Sky Gold Vision 2030.
management_commitments.quote: with an overall target to reach 52 days by 2030 in the Sky Gold Vision 2030 that we are looking at.

management_commitments.claim: Beginning FY27, promoters will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model linked entirely to dividends.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
